name: git-canonical-gate
summary: Use when Git pushes need authentic canonical gate receipts and cached retries.

exit_codes.0: validated canonical gate, successful fallback, help or dry-run; other unlisted codes propagate the unconfigured native gate status
exit_codes.1: configured producer, target, receipt or gate failed
exit_codes.3: missing runtime/dependency or Git configuration lookup failed

distinct_from.reason: git-canonical-gate validates canonical gate receipts and retry reuse; check-no-dashes checks text for Unicode dash characters

origin.promoted_from: a pre-push gate hook (shell and TypeScript) from the maintainer's Rice Observe repository
